semantics: At least 80% of scored 50Hz states must SIMULTANEOUSLY meet locomotion and manipulation bounds; full horizon and whole-episode observable safety also required.
calibration_basis: Pre-comparison mature Isaac WBC errors: XY RMSE about 0.11-0.17m/s, yaw 0.04-0.06rad/s, EE 0.01-0.05m, angle 0.01-0.04rad. Bounds chosen before either training arm; independent calibration rollout must be recorded before lock.
safety_scope: 50Hz contact history/height/tilt/finite-state proxy plus original terminations. Original asset self collision disabled; no self-collision, obstacle or sim-to-real safety claim. Foot contacts are allowed. Safety includes first 3s.
